profiles.description: Security audit subcategories including process, object access, WFP connection and removable-storage activity. File System and Registry coverage requires object SACLs.
profiles.warning: Host-wide WFP connection and removable-storage auditing can generate high Security log volume. Removable Storage audits all access without object SACL filtering. Review log capacity before deployment.

profiles.description: Enablement and retention settings for the Security channel only.
profiles.warning: Increasing Security log retention consumes additional disk space.
